evidence.observation: Each antecedent is independent of circular_area_pre, while every usable postcondition requires it to equal the non-null area address (or, for GetDataLength, alternatively zero). Choosing circular_area_pre distinct from both values refutes the implication whenever the canonical backing state is inhabited.

blockers.required_repair: Return to the C annotation. Strengthen the non-null paths so the pre-state function argument/address identity is explicitly retained at the return point and appears as a premise in every regenerated non-null return VC (for example, add the precise QCP pre-state bridge expected by the annotation language rather than relying only on the current-state equality). Apply the same repair inside nested CircularAreaIsFull and CircularAreaGetDataLength, then rerun canonical symbolic execution and vc-checking.
